questions.question: Write an account of gout disease in birds.
questions.solution_html:
• Gout is a metabolic disorder in birds caused by the accumulation of uric acid in the body, leading
  • to joint swelling and discomfort. Birds affected bygout show clinical signs such as swollen joints
  • difficulty in movement, lethargy, weight loss, and in severe cases, kidney failure. The condition is
  • diagnosed based on these visible symptoms. Treatment involves lifelong administration of
  • medications like allopurinol, which helps reduce uric acid production. Control of the disease
  • focuses on dietary management by avoiding high-purine foods such as organ meats and certain
  • seeds. Providing a balanced, low-purine diet along with fluid therapy is essential to prevent
  • dehydration and support theelimination ofexcess uricacid.
questions.final_answer: dehydration and support theelimination ofexcess uricacid

questions.question: Describe Diabetes Mellitus and Rabies of cat.
questions.solution_html:
• Diabetes mellitus is a metabolic disorder caused by insulin deficiency or resistance. Obesity
  • genetics, and pancreatic issues are major risk factors. Symptoms include increased thirst
  • urination, appetite, weight loss, lethargy, and poor coat. Diagnosis involves checking glucose
  • levels in blood and urine. Treatment includes insulin, medication, and a high-protein, low
  • carbohydrate diet. Regularmonitoring and preventing obesity are essential.
  • Rabies is a deadly viral disease (Lyssavirus) that affects the nervous system and is spread through
  • bites from infected animals. Symptoms include behavioral changes, salivation, difficulty
  • swallowing, paralysis, and seizures. Diagnosis is confirmed post-mortem. There is no cure once
  • symptoms start. Prevention includes rabies vaccination and keeping cats indoors.
questions.final_answer: symptoms start. Prevention includes rabies vaccination and keeping cats indoors
